description: This Java source file defines the JwtAuthenticationProvider class, which handles JWT-based authentication for HTTP requests within the Eclipse Ditto security gateway. It includes methods for checking applicability, extracting JWT tokens from requests, validating tokens, and generating authentication results.

classes.name: JwtAuthenticationProvider
classes.description: Provides JWT-based authentication handling for HTTP requests in the security gateway, including extraction, validation, and converting JWT tokens into authentication results.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of JwtAuthenticationProvider with specified JWT authentication result provider and validator.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks whether the request contains a Bearer JWT authorization header.

methods.name: tryToAuthenticate
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate the request by extracting and validating the JWT, returning an authentication result.

methods.name: extractJwtFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts a JWT token from the Authorization header of the HTTP request.

methods.name: buildMissingJwtException
methods.description: Builds an exception indicating that JWT was missing in the request.

methods.name: getAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Validates the JWT and constructs the corresponding authentication result.

methods.name: buildJwtUnauthorizedException
methods.description: Builds an exception for an invalid or unverifiable JWT.

methods.name: tryToGetAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Uses the jwtAuthResultProvider to generate an authentication result based on the JWT.

methods.name: toFailedAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Creates a failed authentication result from the given throwable, indicating failure reason.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the authorization context type, which is JWT.
